name: 中级模板-飞行堡垒
data:
#注释是一些提示，请结合助手的代码表使用该中级模板
[core]
name: experimentalDropshipTemplate
class: CustomUnitMetadata
price: 30000
maxHp: 8000
mass: 90000

#单位标题
displayText:示范飞行堡垒

#单位描述
displayDescription:强大的飞行堡垒，可以对空对地，有自我修复，能生产和运输单位。请参考ini里面的注释和结合代码表使用。

#设定为初始单位 在游戏的初始单位那个选项卡里面可见
isPickableStartingUnit: true

#开局从天而降
startFallingWhenStartingUnit: true

#科技等级
techLevel: 1

#实验单位
experimental: true

buildSpeed: 0.0002
#availableInDemo: true

radius: 25
#displayRadius: 25

isBio: false
softCollisionOnAll: 3

#最大运输量
maxTransportingUnits: 12

#工厂生成单位速度变快3倍
nanoFactorySpeed:3

#每秒资金
generation_credits: 4
generation_delay: 40

#回血速度
selfRegenRate:0.4

#transportUnitsKillOnDeath: if self.isOverLiquid()
#transportUnitsHealBy: 1

#生成位置与地点
builtFrom_1_name: experimentalLandFactory
builtFrom_1_pos:  5.1


#可生成什么
canBuild_1_name: builder, scout
canBuild_1_pos:  1

canBuild_2_name: combatEngineer
canBuild_2_pos:  1

canBuild_3_name: tank, hoverTank
canBuild_3_pos:  2

canBuild_4_name: heavyTank, plasmaTank, mammothTank, missileTank
canBuild_4_pos:  3

canBuild_5_name: laserTank
canBuild_5_pos:  4


exit_x:0
exit_y:10

exit_dirOffset:0
exit_moveAwayAmount:140



[graphics]
total_frames: 1

image:        CORE:/experimental_dropship/experimental_dropship.png
image_wreak:  CORE:/experimental_dropship/experimental_dropship_dead.png
image_turret: SHARED:small_laser_turret.png
#scaleImagesTo: 20
#scaleTurretImagesTo: 9

#imageScale: 1.5

image_shadow: AUTO
shadowOffsetX:1
shadowOffsetY:1

#movementEffect: CUSTOM:engineTrail
#movementEffectRate: 6


[attack]
canAttack: true
canAttackFlyingUnits: true
#在没有飞起来的时候才能攻击敌人 动态逻辑
canAttackLandUnits:   if not self.flying
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false

turretSize: 18
turretTurnSpeed: 4
maxAttackRange: 210
shootDelay: 25

turretMultiTargeting: true


[turret_1]
x: -20
y: -17

shoot_sound:plasma_fire
shoot_sound_vol:0.05
shoot_flame:small
shoot_light:#FFccCCEE

recoilOffset: -1
recoilOutTime: 4
recoilReturnTime: 6

[turret_2]
#复制炮塔1的数据
copyFrom: 1
x: 20
y: -17
warmup:7
#链接炮塔1
linkDelayWithTurret:1

#抛射体
[projectile_1]
directDamage: 35
life: 70
speed: 7

#索引
frame: 11

#你也可以直接使用自己的图片
#image:example.png

lightColor: #FFccCCEE
lightSize: 0.4

#移动方式
[movement]
movementType: AIR
moveSpeed: 1.1
moveAccelerationSpeed: 0.01
moveDecelerationSpeed: 0.01

landOnGround: true


maxTurnSpeed: 1.3
turnAcceleration: 0.05

moveSlidingMode :true
moveIgnoringBody:true
moveSlidingDir:  45

slowDeathFall: true

#效果组
[effect_engineTrail]

#createWhenOverLiquid: false

createWhenZoomedOut: false
priority:low

life: 20
fadeOut: true
attachedToUnit: false
color: #FFEE22
fadeInTime:3
scaleFrom: 0.3
scaleTo: 0.8
alpha: 1.1
#drawUnderUnits:true

ySpeedRelative:-0.7
xSpeedRelativeRandom:0.2

yOffsetRelative: -40

atmospheric: true

stripIndex:effects
frameIndex: 0
